segments.en: That's right and today we're going to be taking you to Christmas morning.

segments.en: It's Christmas Day.

segments.zh: 哦，一年中最好的时间之一。

segments.zh: 你醒来，你闻到了美味鸡蛋和培根的好味道，还有礼物。

segments.en: Yeah, I guess that's when you're a kid though.
segments.zh: 是的，我想那是你还是个孩子的时候。

segments.en: I guess when you're an adult, do you really get excited when you wake up for Christmas?
segments.zh: 我想当你成年时，当你醒来过圣诞节时，你真的会兴奋吗？

segments.en: Hell yeah.

I love Christmas morning even as an adult.
segments.zh: 我喜欢圣诞节的早晨，即使是成年人。

segments.en: Especially I think because of the special breakfast you get like pancakes, scrambled eggs.
segments.zh: 尤其是我认为因为你得到的特别早餐就像煎饼、炒鸡蛋。

segments.en: But anyways, we're going to be taking a look at a situation here where a kid is opening Christmas presents and we're preparing a meal for Christmas because that day people are going to come over.
segments.zh: 但无论如何，我们将在这里看看一个孩子正在打开圣诞礼物的情况，我们正在为圣诞节准备一顿饭，因为那一天人们会过来。

segments.en: So let's listen to this dialogue for the first time.
segments.zh: 所以让我们第一次听这个对话。

It's Christmas.

segments.en: Look, it's six in the morning.
Go back to bed.

segments.en: Can we go open them, please, please?

segments.en: Of course we can, honey.
Bill, come on, get dressed.
Fine.

segments.zh: 反正圣诞老人又没给我带礼物。

segments.en: Bill, honestly, you can be such a grouch sometimes.
segments.zh: 比尔，说真的，你有时候真是爱发牢骚。

segments.en: Look at all these presents under the Christmas tree.

segments.en: Awesome.

segments.en: Yeah, you're right.
It's the first time we're hosting Christmas dinner at our house, so everything has to be perfect.
segments.zh: 这是我们第一次在我们家举办圣诞晚宴，所以一切都必须完美。

segments.en: I got the list right here.
Ham, turkey, mashed potatoes, ingredients for the gravy, and of course, yams.
segments.zh: 火腿、火鸡、土豆泥、做肉汁的材料，当然还有红薯。

segments.en: My dad offered to bring the eggnog, so we should be set.

segments.zh: 所以那里有几个不同而有趣的词，所以让我们现在在语言外卖中看看它们。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
Okay, this first word is not a very happy word.
segments.zh: 好吧，这第一个词不是一个很高兴的词。

segments.en: It's a word that we try not to use too much around the Christmas season, but sometimes you're just tired of people because the holidays is all about people and doing stuff.
segments.zh: 这是一个我们在圣诞节期间尽量不要使用太多的词，但有时你只是厌倦了人们，因为假期是关于人和做事的。

segments.en: Someone who is not being very happy, someone who's a little bit grumpy is called a grouch.
segments.zh: 一个不太快乐的人，一个有点脾气暴躁的人被称为抱怨。

segments.en: Okay, so a person that's not very happy, not very friendly is a grouch.
segments.zh: 好吧，一个不是很开心，不是很友好的人是一个抱怨。

segments.en: I don't want to open presents.
This is stupid.
Okay, that's a grouch.

segments.zh: 好吧，所以一个人是一个抱怨者，或者你可以表现得像个抱怨者，或者是一个抱怨的人。

segments.en: Don't be a grouch!
All right.

segments.zh: 而且，好吧，他们正在谈论前往市场买东西当晚餐，所以要去。

segments.en: Okay, to head to is a way to say to go towards some place or to go somewhere.
segments.zh: 好的，前往是一种说去某个地方或去某个地方的方式。

segments.en: All right, so if I'm driving my car and you ask me where I'm going, I'm saying, oh, I'm heading to the bank.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以如果我开车，你问我要去哪里，我是说，哦，我要去银行。

segments.en: Right, so to head to means to be on your way somewhere, I'm going somewhere.
segments.zh: 对，所以前往意味着要在某个地方的路上，我要去某个地方。

segments.en: It's a way to say that you're in the process of going.
segments.zh: 这是一种说你正在去的过程。

segments.en: You can't say, next year I will head to Alaska.
segments.zh: 你不能说，明年我会去阿拉斯加。

segments.en: It doesn't make as much sense.
You usually say, I'm heading to the bank, or let's head to the market.
segments.zh: 你通常说，我要去银行，或者让我们去市场。

segments.en: And well, they were talking about heading to the market because they are hosting Christmas dinner, so to host.
segments.zh: 好吧，他们正在谈论前往市场，因为他们正在举办圣诞晚餐，所以主持。

segments.en: To host is a very important holiday term.
segments.zh: 主持是一个非常重要的假期。

segments.en: It's a verb, you do it, and it means that you are the person who has the special dinner and your friends and family, they come to your house.
segments.zh: 这是一个动词，你去做，这意味着你是吃特别晚餐的人，你的朋友和家人，他们来你家。

segments.en: Okay, so we could say, this Christmas, I'm hosting the dinner at my house.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们可以说，今年圣诞节，我在家里举办晚宴。

segments.en: So, I want everyone to come to my house and eat.
segments.zh: 所以，我希望每个人都来我家吃饭。

segments.en: All right, and it can also be a noun, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，它也可以是一个名词，对吧？

segments.en: You can say, I am a host.
Exactly.
I'm the host of this dinner.
segments.zh: 我是这顿晚宴的主持人。

segments.en: Right, and it doesn't have to be holidays either.
You could say, hey, Marco, how about you host a dinner next week?
segments.zh: 你可以说，嘿，马可，你下周举办晚宴怎么样？

segments.en: I'll come.
Right, okay.
I'll bring wine.
All right, so to host a dinner or to host a party, etc.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以要举办晚宴或举办派对等。

segments.en: And our fourth word for language takeaway is probably the most popular drink during the Christmas season, eggnog.
segments.zh: 我们的第四个语言外卖词可能是圣诞节期间最受欢迎的饮料，Eggnog。

segments.en: Okay, it sounds kind of disgusting.
Yeah, a drink with egg.
But it's a very popular creamy eggy drink.
segments.zh: 但它是一种非常受欢迎的奶油蛋类饮料。

segments.en: It's very thick and it's cream colored.
segments.zh: 它很厚，而且是奶油色的。

segments.en: And normally, you add a little bit of rum.
Okay, so it's alcoholic.
And you drink it warm and it's kind of just a thick, warm alcoholic beverage that's very very popular and my dad loves it.
segments.zh: 你喝它很热，它只是一种浓稠、温暖的酒精饮料，非常非常受欢迎，我爸爸喜欢它。

segments.en: During Christmas, right?
During Christmas.

It's too heavy.
But it's very very popular like the days before Christmas and on Christmas.

Very good.

segments.zh: 确切地说，所以父母经常和孩子一起使用它，因为他们希望他们的孩子睡觉。

segments.en: You can also say it about someone who's up at night worrying, and you say, come on, go back to bed.

segments.en: The holiday season can be exhausting, and I know a lot of families have a special dinner on the 24th.

segments.en: That's Christmas Eve, and then by the time it's Christmas Day, the 25th, you're exhausted, you didn't get any sleep, you might have had too much to drink last night, and so it can be very tiring.
